query:
SELECT 
  SUM(CAST(finalAmount AS DECIMAL(10,2))) as total_revenue,
  COUNT(*) as num_sales
FROM sales 
WHERE MONTH(CONVERT_TZ(saleDate, '+00:00', '-03:00')) = 12 
  AND YEAR(CONVERT_TZ(saleDate, '+00:00', '-03:00')) = 2025
  AND status != 'CANCELLED';
